# Saccharomyces cerevisiae: Species Guidance

Budding yeast can be haploid or diploid and can switch between clonal growth,
mating, sporulation, and tetrad-derived offspring. State ploidy, mating type,
sexual-cycle frequency, and whether a simulation represents laboratory crosses
or natural isolates. A diploid human-style population model is not a default.

For cross simulations, tetrad/segregant design and marker segregation may be
more informative than generic outbred GWAS assumptions. For expression studies,
condition, growth phase, and batch effects should be recorded explicitly.
